name: Terran_Siege_Tank_Siege_Mode
why_destroy_first_or_not: Highest priority while it is firing at the squad: its long-range splash damage can rapidly injure several Marines. It cannot attack air, but Marines can attack it on the ground.

name: Zerg_Lurker
why_destroy_first_or_not: Very dangerous when burrowed and attacking: its line attack can hit multiple Marines. Marines need detection to target a burrowed Lurker; without detection, move or obtain detection instead of issuing futile focus fire.

name: Protoss_High_Templar
why_destroy_first_or_not: A fragile, energy-dependent spellcaster. Kill it first if it has energy and can use Psionic Storm on the squad; otherwise prioritize immediate weapon threats.

name: Zerg_Defiler
why_destroy_first_or_not: Low durability and potentially devastating support: Plague or Dark Swarm can swing a Marine fight. Prioritize when it has energy and is close enough to affect combat; it has no weapon attack.

name: Protoss_Reaver
why_destroy_first_or_not: Can deal severe splash damage to grouped Marines through Scarabs. Prioritize while it is in range and firing; the source lists no direct weapon here, so its attack is indirect.

name: Terran_Firebat
why_destroy_first_or_not: Especially dangerous at close range against clustered Marines: its attack hits multiple targets. If it is still far away, deal with long-range or spell threats first.

name: Zerg_Infested_Terran
why_destroy_first_or_not: A suicide attacker near the squad can inflict major damage on contact. Focus it immediately if it is approaching; its threat falls sharply if it is distant.

name: Protoss_Archon
why_destroy_first_or_not: Its area damage threatens grouped Marines on both ground and air. It has a large shield pool, so focus it when it is engaging or approaching rather than switching targets repeatedly.

name: Terran_Science_Vessel
why_destroy_first_or_not: No weapon, but Irradiate can devastate biological Marines. Prioritize if it is using or preparing Irradiate on the squad; otherwise an active attacker is usually more urgent.

name: Protoss_Dark_Templar
why_destroy_first_or_not: Extremely dangerous melee damage if it can reach the squad, but it is permanently cloaked. Marines cannot target it without detection; get detection first, and then focus it while it is closing.

name: Zerg_Queen
why_destroy_first_or_not: Can use disabling or lethal abilities such as Ensnare or Broodling. Prioritize when it has energy and can affect the fight; it does not directly attack Marines.

name: Protoss_Dark_Archon
why_destroy_first_or_not: Its abilities can disable or convert units, but it has no weapon and a large shield pool. Target it when it is in ability range with energy; otherwise remove active attackers first.

name: Protoss_Arbiter
why_destroy_first_or_not: Its cloaking support can make nearby enemies untargetable without detection, and it can attack both ground and air. Prioritize when its support is affecting the engagement; otherwise its durability can make it a slow target.

name: Zerg_Hydralisk
why_destroy_first_or_not: Efficient ranged attacker against both ground and air with modest durability. A good focus target when it is firing at Marines, especially if the squad can eliminate it quickly.

name: Protoss_Dragoon
why_destroy_first_or_not: Ranged attack works against ground and air and it has shields, so it is a substantial threat. Focus it when actively firing; avoid scattering Marine damage across several Dragoons.

name: Terran_Marine
why_destroy_first_or_not: A direct ranged threat to Marines and easy for three Marines to eliminate together. Prioritize exposed or low-health Marines, but prefer splash and spell threats when those are imminent.

name: Zerg_Mutalisk
why_destroy_first_or_not: Fast flyer that attacks ground and air; its bouncing attack can damage nearby Marines. Focus it if it is attacking the squad or can be killed before it escapes.

name: Terran_Goliath
why_destroy_first_or_not: Can attack both ground and air, but is relatively durable. Focus when it is dealing damage to the squad or threatening an important air unit; lower priority than urgent splash or spell threats.

name: Zerg_Guardian
why_destroy_first_or_not: Long-range ground attacker that can hit Marines but cannot attack air. Prioritize if it is firing on the squad; otherwise its slow speed and ground-only weapon can make it less urgent.

name: Terran_Ghost
why_destroy_first_or_not: Low durability, ranged, and potentially dangerous through special abilities. Focus when it is attacking or using an ability on the squad; its value is conditional rather than an automatic first target.

name: Protoss_Scout
why_destroy_first_or_not: Can attack both ground and air, so it can damage Marines, but its large health and shield pool makes it slower to remove. Focus it when it is attacking and there is no more urgent threat.

name: Terran_Wraith
why_destroy_first_or_not: Fast flyer with attacks against both ground and air; it may also cloak. Focus it if attacking the squad, but detection is required if cloaked and higher-impact threats should take precedence.

name: Terran_Siege_Tank_Tank_Mode
why_destroy_first_or_not: Still dangerous as a ground attacker, but generally less urgent than a Siege Mode tank currently firing into the squad. Its weapon cannot attack air.

name: Protoss_Zealot
why_destroy_first_or_not: High melee damage if it reaches the Marines. Focus it when it is closing or already in contact; while it is distant, ranged threats can usually deal damage sooner.

name: Zerg_Zergling
why_destroy_first_or_not: Low health and individually cheap, but fast and dangerous in melee or in a large group. Focus nearby attackers that are about to connect; do not waste shots on distant Zerglings over active ranged threats.

name: Terran_Vulture
why_destroy_first_or_not: Fast ground attacker, but it cannot attack air and its direct threat is usually lower than splash units or ranged attackers. Raise priority if it is dealing damage or laying mines around the squad.

name: Protoss_Carrier
why_destroy_first_or_not: A major threat when Interceptors are attacking, but it is a durable, indirect-attack target. Focus it if it is actively engaging and Marines can sustain fire; otherwise remove nearby threats first.

name: Terran_Battlecruiser
why_destroy_first_or_not: Can attack both ground and air and has high durability. It is dangerous if firing on the squad, but its high health makes it a poor first focus target when a fragile threat can be removed sooner.

name: Terran_Valkyrie
why_destroy_first_or_not: Its weapon only attacks air, so it cannot directly damage Marines on the ground. Focus only if protecting friendly air units or if it is the only meaningful target.

name: Protoss_Corsair
why_destroy_first_or_not: Its weapon only attacks air, so it is not a direct threat to Marines. Usually do not choose it first unless friendly air units need protection.

name: Zerg_Devourer
why_destroy_first_or_not: Its weapon only attacks air; it cannot directly damage Marines. Defer it unless it threatens friendly air units.

name: Zerg_Scourge
why_destroy_first_or_not: Suicide attack targets air, not ground Marines. It is not a direct focus-fire threat to this squad; prioritize only when protecting friendly air units.

name: Terran_Medic
why_destroy_first_or_not: Cannot attack Marines, but can heal nearby Terran infantry. Worth targeting if it is sustaining a dangerous group and can be removed safely; otherwise focus the units dealing damage.

name: Zerg_Overlord
why_destroy_first_or_not: No weapon and not an immediate threat to Marines. Its transport/detection/support role can matter in the larger battle, but it is usually not a first focus target.

name: Protoss_Observer
why_destroy_first_or_not: No weapon; its value is detection. Usually ignore it unless its detection is enabling cloaked or burrowed units that are attacking the squad.

name: Terran_Dropship
why_destroy_first_or_not: Cannot attack, but may deliver combat units. Raise priority only if it is actively unloading a dangerous force; otherwise target the loaded or unloaded attackers.

name: Protoss_Shuttle
why_destroy_first_or_not: Cannot attack, but may transport dangerous units. Prioritize only when an imminent unload would threaten the squad; otherwise deal with combat units.
